export.thread_subject: Duplicate payment instructions from Claims Hub - Wave 1

messages.subject: URGENT: Duplicate payment instructions from Claims Hub - Wave 1
messages.body:
Linnea, Aisha,

Corvane Payments Gateway has flagged payment instructions for the same claim and the same amount arriving twice this morning, all from Claims Hub (UK motor). The first ones came through shortly after nine.

Can the squad check payment-orchestrator straight away? We are checking with the gateway and the clearing bank which instructions have already been released.

I have asked the service desk to log a Sev 2.

Thanks,
Alun

Alun Prothero
Payments Operations Manager
Corvane Mutual Insurance Society Limited | Bristol Recoveries Centre
Mobile 07700 900135

messages.subject: RE: URGENT: Duplicate payment instructions from Claims Hub - Wave 1
messages.body:
Alun,

We have found it. payment-orchestrator retried instructions to CPG after a timeout, without an idempotency key, so the gateway treated each retry as a new instruction. The incident is INC-2026-0914 and I have raised CHUB-371 for the fix.

We will send you the list of affected claims as soon as we have matched it against the gateway log.

Linnea

Linnea Sjöberg
Engineering Lead – Fraud & Settlement Squad
Corvane Mutual Insurance Society Limited | Stockholm office (Corvane Mutual Sverige)
Mobile +46 555 01 042

messages.subject: RE: URGENT: Duplicate payment instructions from Claims Hub - Wave 1
messages.body:
All,

The count is confirmed with the gateway: 18 claims paid twice, £41,236.50 in total. No further duplicates since the incident was stabilised this afternoon.

We are issuing recall requests through CPG for every duplicate today and will track them daily until they are all back.

Attached: the list of the 18 claims (claim references only).

Alun

Alun Prothero
Payments Operations Manager
Corvane Mutual Insurance Society Limited | Bristol Recoveries Centre
Mobile 07700 900135

messages.subject: RE: URGENT: Duplicate payment instructions from Claims Hub - Wave 1
messages.body:
Morning all,

For the record: the incident was closed yesterday at 15:45 once no further duplicates were seen. CHUB-371 is the permanent fix, and the Design Authority is looking at making idempotency keys a standard for every payment instruction rather than a one-off fix.

Thank you to Payments Operations and to the squad for a fast response on a difficult first day.

Neil

Neil Haworth
Head of Technology Delivery
Corvane Mutual Insurance Society Limited | London (Group HQ)
Mobile 07700 900132

messages.subject: RE: URGENT: Duplicate payment instructions from Claims Hub - Wave 1
messages.body:
All,

CHUB-371 is deployed to production today. payment-orchestrator now sends an idempotency key with every instruction to CPG, so a retry after a timeout can no longer create a second payment.

The Design Authority also accepted ADR-021 today: idempotency keys for all payment instructions, across every service that sends them.

Linnea

Linnea Sjöberg
Engineering Lead – Fraud & Settlement Squad
Corvane Mutual Insurance Society Limited | Stockholm office (Corvane Mutual Sverige)
Mobile +46 555 01 042
